verdict.rationale: kitty is a locally installed terminal emulator, so the core product runs entirely on the user's own machine. The docs cover a binary installer and building and running from source with Nix. A hands-on probe confirms kitty 0.48.2 installed via the official installer and ran locally. missing for 10: explicit open-source license evidence, detailed build-from-source documentation beyond a section title, independent corroboration of self-built deployments.
